formal_role: Specifies the local density or intensity being accumulated
systems_modeling_role: Determines what the spatial total actually measures
review_warning: The integral is meaningful only if the integrand represents the intended quantity

formal_role: Defines the spatial domain of integration
systems_modeling_role: Determines what is included excluded and aggregated
review_warning: Changing the boundary can change the total and interpretation

formal_role: Defines the area or volume element used in accumulation
systems_modeling_role: Ensures density units combine correctly with spatial units
review_warning: Coordinate transformations require correct area or volume scaling

formal_role: Controls approximation of a continuous integral by cells
systems_modeling_role: Shapes how local variation appears in spatial totals
review_warning: Coarse grids may hide hotspots or edge effects

formal_role: Selects cells or points inside a modeled domain
systems_modeling_role: Separates included from excluded spatial units
review_warning: Mask logic can drive the final total

formal_role: Combines one spatial field with a weighting field
systems_modeling_role: Supports population-weighted exposure demand-weighted burden or risk-weighted summaries
review_warning: Weighted averages can clarify burden but may hide inequality

formal_role: Tests how totals change when domains shift
systems_modeling_role: Reveals robustness of spatial accumulation claims
review_warning: Administrative or computational boundaries may not match system boundaries
